hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Calculate the number of inversions required to group all zeros before ones.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For each zero, the number of required swaps equals the count of ones appearing to its left.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sum these preceding counts across all target elements.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating physical bubble sort swaps takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counter tracks preceding elements with zero extra allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies inversion count property to determine minimum adjacent swaps.
